title: Decision records carry explicit identity and validate fail-closed
statement: Every Markdown file under law/adr/ MUST carry an explicit id in its frontmatter and MUST be scanned wherever it sits, an unreadable or unparseable file MUST fail the scan, a supersedes entry MUST name a known identity, and a catalogued exception MUST be bound to its pinned sha256 so that editing its bytes fails the scan.
rationale: ADR-GOV-0001 makes decision identity explicit and validation fail-closed so the reference signal cannot be quietly edited or extended.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
